# rebar-ui

Headless-first, low-fidelity React components (real Radix UI underneath, styled via `--rebar-*`
CSS custom properties).

Read `robot.md` (ships in this package) first — a single compressed context file covering
Framework Rules vs. Heuristics, component/block-authoring conventions, and using
`@rebar-ui/placement` to build a page. What follows here is a narrower, component-only excerpt.

Building a whole page or screen? Use `@rebar-ui/placement` instead of hand-authoring JSX against
these components directly — measured cheaper, faster, and more consistent than both hand-authored
rebar-ui and hand-authored Ant Design. See that package's own llms.txt/README. What follows is for
direct component-level use only.

For an LLM/coding agent: read `dist/index.d.ts` for the exact prop interface of every component
(one compact file, ~220 lines) instead of the `.tsx` source under `src/components/`. See
`README.md` for install steps and composition recipes.
